# WaferScale_Interconnect_Topology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The arrangement of physical and logical links across a full wafer-scale system, where dual-sided 3D technology permits routing paths that traverse both faces of the wafer. This expands the design space for TCC routing topologies, allowing for shorter paths and higher bisection bandwidth in large-scale chiplet networks.
